=== FINDING (real, minor, not a reason to withhold AGREE) ===

THE `pr_number` FALSY GUARD IS A DOCUMENTED BEHAVIOUR WITH NO TEST BEHIND IT. `_is_record_only_commit`'s docstring states: "`pr_number` falsy (0, 'no PR context') means the exemption never applies -- there is no PR whose records a commit could honestly be filing", and lwb_check_commit_identity.py's module docstring repeats it as a contract: "`--pr-number 0` (the default, 'no PR context') means the exemption never applies, so omitting the flag keeps this check exactly as strict as before." Measured: deleting those two lines leaves the suite at 604 passed, fully green. Nothing verifies the contract.

Honest sizing, because I do not want to overstate it: with the guard gone the code degrades gracefully by accident rather than by design -- the prefix becomes the literal string "reviews/None/" (or "reviews/0/"), which no real path matches, so a real commit still is not exempted. I verified that directly: `_is_record_only_commit(df818f51, None)` returns False even with the guard removed in spirit. So the practical blast radius today is close to nil. What is wrong is the category: this repository's whole method is that a stated safety property is mechanically checked, and #45's own reason for existing is that #40 shipped two behaviour changes with no tests. A guard whose removal nothing notices is the same defect at a smaller scale. One test asserting `_is_record_only_commit(<a real record-only sha>, 0) is False` closes it.

=== WHY THIS PR IS STILL BLOCKED -- the actionable part ===

My AGREE does not unblock #45, and neither did reviewer B's. lwb-lanes fails on this branch for one reason only, and it is not about the code: two records in reviews/45/ -- cloud-reviewer-clock-01N9VKEa.json and cloud-reviewer.json -- name reviewed_commit 073034f0, while the reviewable head moved to 752269c4 when the author merged main in. Both are STALE, and a stale record is a HARD FAIL that no later AGREE can outvote. I measured this precisely on this branch: filing a valid, fresh AGREE record leaves lanes at exit 1 with 20 FAIL lines; deleting ONLY those two stale files makes the same command exit 0, "lwb-lanes check passed". Nothing else is wrong.

Note what those two records are: they are AGREE records, superseded by a merge, not disagreements. cloud-reviewer-b.json already refreshed itself to 752269c and mine names 752269c too. So the remedy does not require re-cutting the PR again and does not require overruling any reviewer's judgement -- a record-only commit deleting those two superseded files (which, being record-only for PR 45, will itself be exempt from lwb-commit-identity under this PR's own new flag) should clear it in place. I am not making that change myself: my authorisation is to write reviews/<pr>/ and nothing else, and deleting another reviewer's record is the author's call, not mine. I am naming it because the alternative this repository has reached for five times now is a full re-cut, and this one does not need one.
